title: Determiners and quantifiers · 限定词与数量词
pattern: each / every + singular noun  ·  both / either / neither + plural noun  ·  few + countable  ·  little + uncountable
summary: 每个数量词都有固定搭配：each 与 every 指“每一个”，few 与 little 分别接可数与不可数名词，enough 与 too 的位置也有规定。
explanation: **each 与 every** 都表示“每一个”，但 **each** 更强调个体，可单独使用，也可接 of 短语：**Each** of the students received a certificate.（每位学生都拿到了证书。）**every** 强调整体中的每一个，后面直接接单数名词，不能接 of：Every student in the class passed.（班上每个学生都通过了。）因此不要说 Every of the students。
**all 与 whole** 都能表示“全部”，但搭配不同：all 后面接复数或不可数名词（all the time、all my friends），whole 后面接单数名词（the whole day）。中文说“整个下午”，英语应写 **the whole afternoon** 或 all afternoon，不能写 whole the afternoon 或 whole of day。
**both、either、neither** 只用于两者之间：**both** 表示“两者都”，**either** 表示“两者中的任一个”，**neither** 表示“两者都不”。这三个词作主语时，要和谓语保持一致的单数或复数形式：Neither of the answers **is** correct.（两个答案都不对。）
**few 与 little** 的区别在于名词类型：few 接可数名词，表示“很少”；little 接不可数名词，表示“很少”。带 a 时意思变成“有一些”，语气更积极：I have **a few** friends in Berlin.（我在柏林有几个朋友。）I have **little** money left.（我几乎没钱了。）
**enough 与 too**：enough 可以修饰名词（enough time），放在名词前；修饰形容词或副词时要放在其后（tall enough）。too 则放在形容词或副词前，表示“过于”：The water is **too cold** for swimming.（水太凉，不能游泳。）中文的“足够”“太”位置相同，但英语对词序要求很严格。
mistakes: ✗ Every of the students passed the exam. → ✓ Each of the students passed the exam. every 后面不能直接接 of，要用 each of 或 every one of。
✗ I waited whole the afternoon. → ✓ I waited the whole afternoon. whole 要放在定冠词 the 之后，修饰名词 afternoon。
✗ I have few money, so I cannot buy lunch. → ✓ I have little money, so I cannot buy lunch. few 只接可数名词，money 是不可数名词，应用 little。
✗ He is enough tall to play basketball. → ✓ He is tall enough to play basketball. enough 修饰形容词时要放在形容词之后。

examples.text: Each student received a certificate at the end of the course.
examples.translation: 课程结束时，每位学生都拿到了一张证书。

examples.text: Every room in the hotel has a sea view.
examples.translation: 酒店的每个房间都能看到海景。

examples.text: I waited for the whole morning.
Both my parents work in the hospital.
examples.translation: 我父母俩都在医院工作。

examples.text: Neither of the answers is correct.
examples.note: neither 作主语时，谓语多用单数。

examples.text: I have a few friends in Berlin, so I am not lonely.
examples.translation: 我在柏林有几个朋友，所以我不孤单。

examples.text: We have enough time to have a quick coffee before the meeting.
examples.translation: 我们在开会前有足够的时间喝杯咖啡。

exercises.sentence: ___ of the two answers is correct.
options: Both
Every
Neither
Whole
exercises.explanation: 表示“两者都不”用 neither，作主语时谓语用单数 is。

exercises.sentence: I have ___ money left, so I can't buy lunch.
exercises.translation: 我几乎没钱了，所以买不起午饭。
options: few
little
many
a few
exercises.explanation: money 是不可数名词，表示“很少”用 little。

exercises.sentence: The water is ___ cold for swimming.
options: enough
very much
so many
too
exercises.explanation: “太……”用 too 修饰形容词 cold。

exercises.source: 我整个下午都在写报告。
options: I spent whole afternoon writing the report.
I spent all afternoon the writing report.
I spent the whole afternoon writing the report.
I spent every the afternoon writing the report.
exercises.explanation: “整个下午”用 the whole afternoon，whole 放在 the 之后。

options: There are enough chairs in the room.
There are enough of chairs in the room.
There are enough chair in the room.
There is enough chairs in the room.
exercises.explanation: enough 修饰复数可数名词 chairs，放在名词前；谓语用 are。

exercises.source: 我的朋友个个都很友好。
options: Every of my friends are friendly.
Each my friends is friendly.
Each of my friends are friendly.
Each of my friends is friendly.
exercises.explanation: each of 后面接复数名词，但 each 作主语时谓语用单数 is。

options: I have few time to relax this week.
She has a few close friends.
We have little time left.
exercises.explanation: time 是不可数名词，应写成 little time。

options: There are too many people in the room.
He is old enough to vote.
The kids are enough old to go alone.
exercises.explanation: enough 修饰形容词时要放在形容词之后，应写成 old enough。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 这栋楼的每个房间都有自己的阳台。
exercises.explanation: every 后面直接接单数名词 room，谓语用 has。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 我们的食物足够吃一整个星期。
exercises.explanation: enough 修饰名词 food 时放在名词前；the whole week 表示整个星期。
